The Waldorf Astoria New York was purchased by Anbang Insurance Group from Hilton Worldwide in 2014 for $1.95 billion [d1,d5]. After Anbang’s 2020 insolvency, the Chinese government took control of the property via receivership, and Dajia Insurance Group subsequently took over operations [d1,d9]. Hilton continues to manage the brand and the property’s reopening [d4,d1]. These sources together provide complementary information about ownership and control across time.
